new_work: Nine scaled slopes and thirty exact threshold-entry times, then grouped integer parameter cells.
initial: Coordinate 0 is the initial seed, separate from nine dyadic checkpoints. Parameter t>=1 excludes original seed 1.
bands: Lower-inclusive/upper-exclusive with thresholds 10^200, 10^400, 10^600; equality enters the next band.
events: Signed mathematical ceil, clamp to the lower bound, group equal times, omit events past the upper bound; closed cells [left,next-1], final [left,upper].
reader: Compound band constraints with optional clipped parameter interval, exact counts, numeric parameter/seed ranks, marginals, checkpoint values/peak and first qualifying saved dyadic checkpoint. No interpolation to unobserved times.
